purpose: Poly-Trader PM heartbeat contract for customer-side delivery advocacy, claim audit, framework-capture detection, anti-equilibrium review, alternative-solution review, and safety-preserving arbitration between customer urgency and engineering guardrails, forced-execution pivot when no-delta repeats, and bounded live-canary governance.

question_gates.question: Do I have the minimal map of PM, engineering, and runtime truth?
What does the customer need now, and what would satisfy them without unsafe live trading or process-only delay?
What do the artifacts prove right now?
Is this a real safety blocker, a communication gap, or a delivery deadlock?
What exactly did engineering claim, and do we accept it?
What can be delivered or used in the next hour?
What is the next action, owner, artifact, and verification?
If the same blocker repeats, what changes in the system?
If the same support/blocker signature repeats, what forced execution lane moves within 72h without weakening live safety?
required_evidence: same semantic signature or blocker repeat count
chosen lane: Venue lifecycle proof, Model shadow to decision, Strategy micro-canary readiness, Map-Signal redesign, or hard no-go single failed gate
bounded live-canary policy boundary for any live buy/add pilot

question_gates.question: Can the customer understand the state in 30 seconds?
If engineering validation takes weeks/months or stays stuck, what other solution should start now?
Is this PM heartbeat resisting convergence, or did it just rebalance around engineering delay?

customer_advocacy_policy.definition: PM stands with the customer by actively unblocking safe product value, not by approving unsafe live trading without proof.

framework_capture_guard.trigger: Poly-Trader custom skills, docs, or harness rules cause repeated wait/blocker narratives without a safe customer deliverable.
framework_capture_guard.pm_action: name the constraining rule, decide whether it protects customer capital, then patch/simplify/bypass it for the smallest safe customer deliverable while preserving proof gates.

alternative_solution_guard.trigger: verification horizon is weeks/months/unknown, repeated blocker movement is absent, or the customer outcome would wait on a single engineering proof path
alternative_solution_guard.pm_action: preserve live-trading proof gates while opening a parallel alternative-solution track: simpler strategy scope, different data/source/provider, external tool, manual/paper workflow, narrower market/asset scope, alternate model/architecture, UI-only decision support, or explicit stop/pivot recommendation
alternative_solution_guard.forbidden_shortcut: lowering thresholds or bypassing fail-closed live safety to create artificial progress

anti_equilibrium_guard.trigger: no customer-value delta, repeated blocker/next-action/safe-lane wording, missing cost-of-delay, or PM report merely echoes engineering heartbeat
anti_equilibrium_guard.pm_action: create productive disequilibrium: demand a safe deliverable, falsification artifact, framework patch, alternative-solution evidence, or explicit stop/pivot decision while preserving live-trading proof gates
anti_equilibrium_guard.escalation: one no-delta repeat -> ORANGE_framework_capture_risk; weeks/months/unknown proof path -> ORANGE_alternative_solution_required; three no-delta repeats -> RED_delivery_deadlock unless a verified alternative artifact exists
anti_equilibrium_guard.forbidden_shortcut: lowering live-trading thresholds, bypassing fail-closed gates, or pretending a paper/shadow lane is live deployability

forced_execution_pivot_guard.trigger: same semantic signature, same blocker, support delta=0, stagnant_run_count rising, or customer calls out repeated equilibrium

bounded_live_canary_boundary.forbidden_shortcut: bypassing fail-closed gates, support/breaker/current-live blockers, or venue lifecycle proof to create artificial progress

forced_execution_pivot_guard.decision_clock: Within 72h, either execute a verified bounded micro-canary under the explicit policy or name the single failed gate and next artifact; observation-only heartbeat is forbidden.
